exposure: history of previous abdominal surgery including cesarean section
preoperative use of gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists (GnRHas)
perioperative use of hemostatic agents (tranexamic acid or vasopressin)
cohort: 242 patients who underwent robotic myomectomy at Seoul Asan Hospital between 1 January 2019, and 28 February 2021
finding: The number of myomas (5-9 and >=10), maximal myoma diameter, and history of abdominal surgery other than cesarean section affect the EBL in RM.
